purpose: Population and draw for the independent hand audit of the `self` rule (docs/plans/connected-code-graph-p1-extraction.md, 5d: owner data-scientist; the implementer does not run it). The audit is not done here.
method: The repo's Python units rebuilt at builtCommit: `extract.sc` (sha256 below, unchanged by P1-50) run over each unit's stored CPG (.ccg-work/joern/<unitId>/cpg), `assemble` at normalizer 0.7 (the `self` rule counts the unit's definers); population = every call site `report['selfResolvedSites']` lists, sorted by call-site id; drawn = random.Random(seed).sample(population, 30), in sample order, the same seed over the new population. `astCensus` is the independent `ast` single-definer count of each unit's stage tree (tests/overlay_5d.py:ast_self_sites, which never imports `assemble`) against the population; `onlyInAst` lists reference sites `assemble` does not confirm because Joern's fact lists no candidate for them.

previous.note: The first draw (P1-05 5d, normalizer 0.6; the analyst's 5d diff gate (F1) found a118e830a3fd791d5a6b2c9e6f2cf705 in it: Joern had narrowed the site to the base method while an in-unit test double overrides it).
